entries.text: Fixed differentiation of matrix inverses with respect to a scalar, so that `Inverse(x*X + Z).diff(x)` now gives `-(x*X + Z)**-1*X*(x*X + Z)**-1`, and `Trace(Inverse(x*X + Z)).diff(x)` no longer raises a `TypeError`.
